profile.summary: Amergis Healthcare Staffing is a national healthcare staffing company. It places nurses, allied health professionals, behavioral health professionals and other clinicians in hospitals, schools, government health programs, correctional facilities and managed care organizations. It was formerly known as Maxim Healthcare Staffing and rebranded as Amergis in April 2024.

sources.title: Maxim Healthcare Staffing is Now Amergis

review.notes: Amergis Healthcare Staffing (formerly Maxim Healthcare Staffing, HQ Columbia, MD) matches the agenda name and location; the contact page confirms address and phone, and the press release confirms the rebrand and the schools/educational staffing scope. One agenda title references Maxim Healthcare Services, which the press release says is a separate sister organization, so that single record may belong to a different entity, but the profile itself is accurate for Amergis.
